title: 🔥 WHO GAVE YOU AUTHORITY TO PREACH? DO YOU HAVE A CHURCH? ARE YOU A PASTOR OR A PRIEST? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 WHO GAVE YOU AUTHORITY TO PREACH? DO YOU HAVE A CHURCH? ARE YOU A PASTOR OR A PRIEST? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, who are you to teach us? Are you a pastor or a priest? Why do you call yourself 'brother'? Who gave you the authority to preach? Why are you preaching here on Facebook—don’t you have a church?"
🚨 THESE QUESTIONS ARE COMMON, BUT THE ANSWER IS SIMPLE—THE BIBLE GIVES EVERY BELIEVER THE AUTHORITY TO SHARE THE GOSPEL!
📖 Key Verse: "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation." (Mark 16:15)
🔥 THE REAL QUESTION IS NOT "WHO CALLED ME?" BUT "WHY AREN’T YOU PREACHING TOO?" 🔥

🔥 1. DO YOU NEED TO BE A PASTOR OR PRIEST TO PREACH THE GOSPEL?
📖 Matthew 28:19-20 – "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you."
💡 JESUS GAVE THE COMMAND TO EVERY DISCIPLE—NOT JUST PASTORS!

✔️ The disciples were not priests—they were fishermen, tax collectors, and common men! (Acts 4:13)
✔️ The early church was filled with ordinary believers preaching everywhere! (Acts 8:4)
✔️ The Great Commission is for every follower of Christ, not just religious leaders! (Matthew 28:19)
🚨 IF YOU BELIEVE IN JESUS, YOU HAVE THE RESPONSIBILITY TO SHARE THE GOSPEL!

🔥 2. WHO GAVE ME AUTHORITY TO PREACH?
📖 Acts 1:8 – "But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."
💡 MY AUTHORITY COMES FROM JESUS CHRIST AND THE HOLY SPIRIT!

✔️ God calls His servants—Not a church organization! (Galatians 1:11-12)
✔️ Jesus Himself appoints His messengers! (John 15:16)
✔️ The Holy Spirit gives power and wisdom to preach! (Acts 1:8)
🚨 MY CALLING COMES FROM GOD, NOT MAN! IF GOD SAYS "PREACH," I WILL PREACH!

🔥 3. WHY DO I PREACH ON FACEBOOK? DON’T I HAVE A CHURCH?
📖 Romans 10:14 – "How can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?"
💡 THE GOSPEL MUST BE PREACHED EVERYWHERE—INCLUDING SOCIAL MEDIA!

✔️ The early disciples preached in streets, houses, marketplaces—not in buildings! (Acts 5:42)
✔️ The church is not a building—the church is the people! (1 Corinthians 3:16)
✔️ Jesus Himself preached outside in public places! (Luke 5:1-3)
🚨 IF SOCIAL MEDIA REACHES MILLIONS, WHY WOULD I STAY SILENT?

🔥 4. WHY DO I CALL MYSELF "BROTHER" AND NOT "PASTOR" OR "PRIEST"?
📖 Matthew 23:8-10 – "But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers. And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and He is in heaven."
💡 TITLES DO NOT GIVE SPIRITUAL AUTHORITY—OBEDIENCE TO GOD DOES!

✔️ Jesus told us to be humble and not seek religious titles! (Matthew 23:8)
✔️ The apostles called each other "brothers" because they were all equal in Christ! (Romans 1:13)
✔️ God cares about FAITHFULNESS, not titles! (1 Corinthians 4:1-2)
🚨 I AM A SERVANT OF GOD, AND THAT IS ENOUGH!

🔥 5. WHAT IF YOU THINK I HAVE NO RIGHT TO PREACH?
📖 1 Corinthians 1:27 – "But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong."
💡 GOD USES ORDINARY PEOPLE TO DO EXTRAORDINARY THINGS!

✔️ MOSES had no confidence, but God used him to deliver Israel! (Exodus 4:10-12)
✔️ DAVID was a shepherd boy, but God made him king! (1 Samuel 16:11-13)
✔️ PETER was a fisherman, but God made him an apostle! (Matthew 4:18-19)
🚨 IF GOD CALLED ME, WHY SHOULD I BE SILENT? AND IF YOU KNOW THE TRUTH, WHY ARE YOU SILENT?

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I AM CALLED TO PREACH THE GOSPEL! I WILL NOT BE SILENT!"

🔥 THE GOSPEL WARRIOR CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 2: Be bold in your faith—speak the truth without fear!
✅ Step 3: Live as a disciple—walk in obedience to Jesus!
🔥 #CalledToPreach #GospelAuthority #BoldFaith #PreachEverywhere #StandForTruth #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis
